verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists a first-party "Conversational meeting assistant" and "search across calls", and its official MCP server exposes meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude. These suggest some natural-language querying of meetings, but nothing documents asking questions across the whole meeting history or getting answers with source citations. The MCP route also relies on an external assistant to produce the answers. Missing for 10: documentation that the assistant answers questions across all past meetings, answers grounded with links or citations to source meetings or timestamps, depth beyond a one-line pricing mention, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can ask questions in natural language across my whole meeting history ("what did we decide about pricing?") and get answers with sources

citations.quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
